common.title: Grade 9 Mathematics - Integrated AP Precalculus Readiness
common.destination: Grade 10 Algebra 2 / AP Readiness for all; Grade 10 AP Precalculus for students demonstrating the complete prerequisite profile.

units.title: Diagnostic Launch and Mathematical Habits
units.intent: Build a trustworthy readiness profile without labeling students by prior school; establish common notation, reasoning routines, technology expectations, and individual support/extension plans.

lessons.title: Course launch: what mathematical readiness looks like
learningOutcomes: Explain the purpose of the Grade 9 pathway and how evidence will be used
Communicate a solution using correct notation and complete reasoning
Classify an error as conceptual, procedural, or communication-based and revise it

lessons.title: Diagnostic A: number and no-calculator fluency
learningOutcomes: Demonstrate prerequisite numerical fluency without technology
Identify personal strengths and prerequisite gaps from diagnostic evidence

lessons.title: Diagnostic B: algebra and equations
learningOutcomes: Simplify algebraic expressions accurately
Solve representative equations and inequalities and justify steps
Rearrange a basic formula for a requested variable

lessons.title: Diagnostic C: functions and graphs
learningOutcomes: Interpret a function from multiple representations
Extract key information from a graph and connect it to a context
Determine whether a relation represents a function

lessons.title: Diagnostic D: geometry, trigonometry, and technology
learningOutcomes: Solve a representative geometric prerequisite task
Use graphing technology to generate a graph and table correctly
Interpret a calculator result rather than reporting it without context

lessons.title: Diagnostic feedback and prerequisite repair plan
learningOutcomes: Read a readiness profile and identify priority gaps
Set measurable short-term mathematical goals
Begin either targeted repair or compacted extension work based on current evidence

lessons.title: Reasoning clinic: equivalent methods and checking
learningOutcomes: Verify a solution numerically and algebraically
Compare two valid methods and explain which is more efficient in a given problem

lessons.title: Readiness profile checkpoint
learningOutcomes: Demonstrate improvement on targeted prerequisite items
Explain the next learning priority and the evidence needed to move into accelerated work

units.title: Algebraic Fluency, Indices, and Surds
units.intent: Create the symbolic fluency required for every later function family while using FLEX time to accelerate students who already possess basic procedural skills.

lessons.title: Laws of exponents I
learningOutcomes: Simplify numerical and algebraic powers using exponent laws
Explain why equivalent exponent forms represent the same quantity

lessons.title: Negative and fractional exponents
learningOutcomes: Rewrite expressions using positive exponents
Convert between radical and rational-exponent forms
Evaluate expressions with fractional exponents exactly

lessons.title: Radicals and surds: simplification
learningOutcomes: Simplify square and higher-order radicals
Combine like radicals while preserving exact values

lessons.title: Operations with radicals and rationalizing denominators
learningOutcomes: Perform operations with radical expressions
Rationalize a denominator using an appropriate factor or conjugate
Maintain exact values in algebraic and geometric problems

lessons.title: Collecting like terms and structure
learningOutcomes: Simplify multi-term algebraic expressions efficiently
Identify algebraic structure before manipulating an expression

lessons.title: Expanding binomials
subtopics: FOIL as structure, not a rule to memorize
learningOutcomes: Expand products of binomials accurately
Recognize and use difference-of-squares and perfect-square structures

lessons.title: Expanding and simplifying polynomials
learningOutcomes: Multiply polynomials and write results in standard form
Predict the degree and leading term before completing a full expansion

lessons.title: Foundational factorization
learningOutcomes: Factor expressions by identifying common structure
Check a factorization by expansion

lessons.title: Rearranging formulae I
learningOutcomes: Solve a literal equation for a specified variable
Explain restrictions introduced by division or roots

lessons.title: Forming equations from contexts
learningOutcomes: Construct a linear or simple quadratic equation from a context
Define variables and units clearly
Evaluate whether a solution is reasonable in context

lessons.title: Multi-step equations and symbolic checking
learningOutcomes: Solve multi-step linear equations
Recognize one-solution, no-solution, and identity cases
Check a solution by substitution

lessons.title: FLEX accelerator: exponent and radical equations
learningOutcomes: Solve selected equations involving powers and radicals
State and check restrictions
Justify a manipulation using exponent structure rather than pattern matching

lessons.title: Unit synthesis and no-calculator mastery check
learningOutcomes: Select an efficient algebraic method without technology
Demonstrate accurate exponent, radical, expansion, factorization, and formula-rearrangement skills

units.title: Linear Relationships, Equations, and Inequalities
units.intent: Develop a strong concept of rate of change and linear representation so students can later reason about rates of change across polynomial, exponential, and trigonometric functions.

lessons.title: Slope from graphs, tables, and points
learningOutcomes: Calculate slope from multiple representations
Interpret the sign and magnitude of slope

lessons.title: Slope as a rate of change
learningOutcomes: Interpret slope as a rate with units
Compare rates across two linear models and justify which changes faster

lessons.title: Slope-intercept form
learningOutcomes: Write and graph a linear function in slope-intercept form
Interpret slope and intercept in context

lessons.title: Point-slope and standard forms
learningOutcomes: Write a line from a point and slope
Convert among common linear forms and choose a useful representation

lessons.title: Parallel and perpendicular lines
learningOutcomes: Determine whether lines are parallel or perpendicular
Write an equation of a parallel or perpendicular line satisfying given conditions

lessons.title: Linear modeling from data
learningOutcomes: Construct a reasonable linear model from data
Interpret parameters and make a justified prediction
State a sensible domain for a context

lessons.title: Solving linear inequalities
learningOutcomes: Solve linear inequalities and represent solution sets in multiple forms
Explain why multiplying/dividing by a negative reverses the inequality

lessons.title: Compound inequalities
learningOutcomes: Solve compound inequalities
Represent solutions using interval notation and a number line

lessons.title: Absolute-value equations and inequalities
learningOutcomes: Solve basic absolute-value equations and inequalities
Connect algebraic solutions to distance on the number line

lessons.title: Piecewise linear functions
learningOutcomes: Evaluate and graph a piecewise-defined function
Interpret which rule applies on a specified interval
Build a simple piecewise model from a context

lessons.title: Coordinate-geometry applications
learningOutcomes: Use coordinate methods to solve geometric problems
Combine slope, distance, and line equations in a multi-step argument

lessons.title: Technology lab: linear regression and residual thinking
learningOutcomes: Use graphing technology to fit a linear model
Calculate and interpret a residual
Explain why a high visual fit does not remove contextual assumptions

lessons.title: Unit assessment and readiness checkpoint
learningOutcomes: Demonstrate mastery of linear equations, inequalities, graphs, and modeling
Communicate a complete solution across symbolic and graphical representations

units.title: Systems and Coordinate Modeling
units.intent: Move from single relationships to simultaneous constraints and prepare students for AP prerequisite systems in two and three variables.

lessons.title: Systems as intersections
learningOutcomes: Solve a two-variable system graphically
Interpret an intersection as a simultaneous solution in context

lessons.title: Substitution method
learningOutcomes: Solve systems by substitution
Select substitution when one variable is already isolated or easily isolated

lessons.title: Elimination method
learningOutcomes: Solve systems by elimination
Explain how equivalent equation operations preserve the solution set

lessons.title: Choosing a method strategically
learningOutcomes: Choose an efficient method based on system structure
Verify an exact solution graphically or with technology

lessons.title: Systems in context
learningOutcomes: Construct a system from a contextual scenario
Interpret both coordinates of the solution with units

lessons.title: Systems of inequalities
learningOutcomes: Graph a system of linear inequalities
Identify and test points in a feasible region

lessons.title: Three-variable systems
learningOutcomes: Solve selected systems in three variables
Interpret an ordered triple as a simultaneous solution

lessons.title: Systems modeling mini-project and benchmark
learningOutcomes: Build, solve, and interpret a system model
Defend the chosen method and discuss model limitations

units.title: Functions, Piecewise Models, and Transformations
units.intent: Build function fluency as a language for all later mathematics, emphasizing domain, range, multiple representations, composition, inverse functions, and transformations.

lessons.title: Relations, functions, domain, and range
learningOutcomes: Determine whether a relation is a function
State domain and range in appropriate notation
Identify mathematical and contextual restrictions

lessons.title: Function notation and evaluation
learningOutcomes: Evaluate a function from multiple representations
Interpret f(a) in a context with units

lessons.title: Representations and function behavior
learningOutcomes: Describe key graph behavior using interval language
Translate information among graph, table, formula, and verbal descriptions

lessons.title: Average rate of change
learningOutcomes: Calculate average rate of change over an interval
Interpret average rate of change and its units
Compare rates of change across intervals

lessons.title: Operations on functions
learningOutcomes: Perform operations on functions
Determine domain restrictions created by a quotient or other operation

lessons.title: Composition of functions
learningOutcomes: Evaluate a composition numerically and algebraically
Construct a composite function from two component functions
Explain why order matters

lessons.title: Inverse functions
learningOutcomes: Determine whether a function is invertible on a domain
Find and verify a simple inverse algebraically and graphically
Interpret an inverse in context

lessons.title: Piecewise and absolute-value functions
learningOutcomes: Evaluate and graph piecewise functions
Construct a piecewise model for changing rules
Analyze behavior at a boundary

lessons.title: Transformations of graphs
learningOutcomes: Predict how parameters transform a parent graph
Write a transformed function from a verbal or graphical description
Compare original and transformed domains/ranges

lessons.title: Function synthesis and technology lab
learningOutcomes: Use technology strategically to investigate a function
Confirm calculator findings symbolically when feasible
Explain a function using at least three representations

units.title: Quadratic Functions, Equations, and Complex Numbers
units.intent: Ensure every student has the quadratic proficiency explicitly required before AP Precalculus, while extending stronger students into parameter reasoning and complex zeros.

lessons.title: Quadratic graphs and key features
learningOutcomes: Identify key features from a quadratic graph
Interpret the vertex and zeros in context

lessons.title: Standard, factored, and vertex forms
learningOutcomes: Convert among useful quadratic forms
Choose a form based on the feature needed

lessons.title: Factoring quadratics I
learningOutcomes: Factor quadratic trinomials accurately
Use factors to identify zeros

lessons.title: Factoring quadratics II
learningOutcomes: Factor a range of quadratic expressions
Recognize special factoring structures

lessons.title: Solving quadratics by factoring and square roots
learningOutcomes: Solve quadratic equations by factoring or square roots
Check solutions in the original equation

lessons.title: Completing the square
learningOutcomes: Complete the square for a quadratic expression
Solve a quadratic equation by completing the square

lessons.title: Quadratic formula
learningOutcomes: Apply the quadratic formula accurately
Recognize when the formula is the most efficient method

lessons.title: Discriminant and solution type
learningOutcomes: Use the discriminant to classify solutions without fully solving
Connect discriminant sign to x-intercepts

lessons.title: Complex numbers
learningOutcomes: Perform basic operations with complex numbers
Express nonreal quadratic solutions in a+bi form
Connect conjugate roots to real-coefficient quadratics

lessons.title: Quadratic inequalities
learningOutcomes: Solve quadratic inequalities algebraically and graphically
Represent solution sets clearly

lessons.title: Quadratic modeling and regression
learningOutcomes: Construct or fit a quadratic model
Interpret parameters and extrema in context
State domain/range restrictions and assess reasonableness

lessons.title: FLEX accelerator: parameter and root problems
learningOutcomes: Determine parameter values satisfying conditions on roots
Justify conclusions using algebraic structure

lessons.title: Common quadratic benchmark
learningOutcomes: Demonstrate complete prerequisite mastery of quadratic functions and equations
Select and justify an efficient solution method

units.title: Polynomial and Rational Foundations
units.intent: Move beyond quadratics into the polynomial and rational fluency that makes a Grade 10 AP Precalculus start realistic for advanced students and makes Grade 10 readiness work much stronger for everyone.

lessons.title: Polynomial operations and structure
learningOutcomes: Perform polynomial operations accurately
Predict degree and leading-term behavior from structure

lessons.title: Factoring higher-degree polynomials
learningOutcomes: Factor selected higher-degree polynomials
Use structure to choose an efficient factoring strategy

lessons.title: Zeros, factors, and multiplicity
learningOutcomes: Determine real zeros from a factored polynomial
Connect multiplicity to local graph behavior

lessons.title: Polynomial graphs and end behavior
learningOutcomes: Predict polynomial end behavior
Sketch a polynomial from zeros, multiplicities, and end behavior
Use technology to verify but not replace reasoning

lessons.title: Polynomial long division
learningOutcomes: Divide polynomials using long division
Express a polynomial using quotient and remainder form

lessons.title: Synthetic division and remainder/factor theorems
learningOutcomes: Use synthetic division for linear divisors
Use the remainder and factor theorems to evaluate and test factors

lessons.title: Rational expressions and restrictions
learningOutcomes: State restrictions before simplifying a rational expression
Simplify rational expressions while preserving excluded values

lessons.title: Multiplying and dividing algebraic fractions
learningOutcomes: Multiply and divide rational expressions
Track all original domain restrictions

lessons.title: Adding and subtracting algebraic fractions
learningOutcomes: Add and subtract rational expressions with unlike denominators
Simplify final results and state restrictions

lessons.title: Rational equations
learningOutcomes: Solve rational equations
Reject solutions that violate original restrictions

lessons.title: Rational-function graph features
learningOutcomes: Distinguish zeros, holes, and vertical asymptotes from algebraic structure
Sketch a basic rational graph from factored form

lessons.title: Polynomial/rational unit assessment
learningOutcomes: Demonstrate polynomial and rational prerequisite skills
Connect equivalent algebraic forms to graph features

units.title: Sequences, Exponential Functions, and Logarithm Preview
units.intent: Develop multiplicative-change reasoning and give AP-track candidates enough logarithmic familiarity to enter Grade 10 AP Precalculus without a conceptual shock.

lessons.title: Arithmetic sequences
learningOutcomes: Recognize an arithmetic sequence
Write and use an explicit nth-term rule
Interpret common difference as constant additive change

lessons.title: Geometric sequences
learningOutcomes: Recognize a geometric sequence
Write and use an explicit nth-term rule
Interpret common ratio as multiplicative change

lessons.title: Recursive and explicit representations
learningOutcomes: Write recursive and explicit rules for arithmetic and geometric sequences
Compare the information revealed by each representation

lessons.title: Linear vs. exponential change
learningOutcomes: Distinguish additive and multiplicative patterns
Choose between linear and exponential models and justify the choice

lessons.title: Exponential functions and graph features
learningOutcomes: Identify key characteristics of an exponential function
Graph exponential growth and decay from parameters

lessons.title: Growth, decay, and percent change
learningOutcomes: Construct an exponential model from a percent rate
Interpret parameters and make contextual predictions

lessons.title: Technology lab: exponential regression and residuals
learningOutcomes: Fit an exponential model with technology
Interpret residuals and compare a competing linear model
State limits of extrapolation

lessons.title: Logarithms as inverses of exponentials
learningOutcomes: Rewrite between exponential and logarithmic form
Evaluate simple logarithms exactly
Explain why logarithms undo exponentiation

lessons.title: Logarithm laws
learningOutcomes: Apply logarithm laws to rewrite expressions
Use change of base with technology when appropriate

lessons.title: Exponential and logarithmic equations
learningOutcomes: Solve selected exponential and logarithmic equations
Check solutions against domain restrictions

lessons.title: Sequences/exponential benchmark
learningOutcomes: Demonstrate additive vs. multiplicative reasoning
Construct and interpret sequence and exponential models

units.title: Geometry and Trigonometry for Precalculus
units.intent: Complete the right-triangle trigonometry prerequisite for all students and introduce radians/unit-circle thinking for students targeting Grade 10 AP Precalculus.

lessons.title: Similarity and Pythagoras
learningOutcomes: Use similarity to determine missing lengths
Apply Pythagoras in 2D and 3D contexts

lessons.title: Trigonometric ratios
learningOutcomes: Select and apply an appropriate trigonometric ratio
Explain ratios relative to a chosen acute angle

lessons.title: Solving right triangles
learningOutcomes: Solve a right triangle from sufficient information
Use inverse trigonometric functions correctly and report sensible precision

lessons.title: Angles of elevation and depression
learningOutcomes: Translate a verbal context into a correct triangle model
Solve elevation/depression problems and interpret results

lessons.title: Multi-step 2D/3D trigonometry
learningOutcomes: Solve multi-step geometric problems using Pythagoras and trigonometry
Justify the sequence of geometric relationships used

lessons.title: Exact trigonometric values preview
learningOutcomes: Derive exact values for special angles
Use exact values without decimal approximation

lessons.title: Radians and angle measure
learningOutcomes: Convert between degrees and radians
Interpret radian measure geometrically

lessons.title: Unit circle preview
learningOutcomes: Determine sine and cosine values from unit-circle coordinates
Use symmetry and reference angles for selected exact values

lessons.title: Sine, cosine, and tangent graphs preview
learningOutcomes: Sketch one cycle of sine, cosine, and tangent
Identify period and key graph features

lessons.title: Basic trigonometric identities preview
learningOutcomes: Verify and apply the basic Pythagorean identity
Rewrite a simple trigonometric expression using an identity

lessons.title: Trigonometry performance task
learningOutcomes: Construct and solve a trigonometric model
Communicate a complete geometric argument with units and justified precision

units.title: Integrated Readiness Capstone and Grade 10 Pathway Decision
units.intent: Use multiple measures to determine the appropriate Grade 10 starting point while giving every student a specific bridge plan rather than a permanent label.

lessons.title: Cumulative prerequisite diagnostic
learningOutcomes: Demonstrate cumulative prerequisite mastery across core domains
Identify any remaining domain below readiness expectation

lessons.title: Multiple-representation function challenge
learningOutcomes: Translate between representations
Explain function behavior and rates of change using precise language

lessons.title: No-calculator fluency clinic
learningOutcomes: Complete key symbolic tasks efficiently without technology
Analyze and correct recurring procedural errors

lessons.title: Calculator modeling clinic
learningOutcomes: Use graphing technology strategically
Verify and interpret technology results rather than reporting screen output only

lessons.title: AP-style bridge task
learningOutcomes: Complete an AP-like multi-part function task
Support conclusions with mathematical evidence and context

lessons.title: Final readiness examination
learningOutcomes: Demonstrate the complete evidence profile needed for Grade 10 placement consideration

lessons.title: Student conference and summer bridge plan
learningOutcomes: Explain the pathway recommendation using evidence
Identify the specific summer work needed to protect future AP access
